name: pdfRead
description: Reads a PDF file (by path or as a Binary) into a shared, reference-typed PDF object. The parsed document is a native object: passing it around costs nothing and every handle sees the same document. Throws a runtime error if the file is not a PDF, is truncated, or uses an encryption the engine cannot open.

params.name: pathOrBinary
params.description: Absolute path to a PDF file, or a Binary containing the PDF bytes.

examples.title: Read a PDF file
examples.description: Open a PDF and inspect its metadata.
